	name = "Yeshe_Tsogyal" #Concubine of Trisong Detsen, later Tantric consort of Padmasambhava

	culture = bodpa

	trait = chaste

	}

		add_trait = saint
		death = yes
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:9231 # Qusum, for the hermitage of Chimphu above Samye
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:buddhism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_buddhism_vajrayana_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
			if = { # No relics: she dissolved into light
				limit = {
					title:c_zetang.holder ?= { faith = { has_saint_character = character:247114 } }
				}
				title:c_zetang.holder = {
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:247114
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:247114
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:247114
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:247114
				}
				set_global_variable = MB_norelic_247114
			}
		}
	}
}

MB_kharatara_jinadatta = { # Jinadatta Suri, the first Dadaguru, born 1075, initiated 1084, made suri at Chittor in 1112, honoured by the Chahamana Arnoraja, who brought whole clans into the faith and died at Ajmer in 1154
	name = "Jinadatta"
	rite = kharatara
	culture = gujarati
	martial = 3
	diplomacy = 8
	intrigue = 5
	stewardship = 6
	learning = 9
	trait = education_learning_4
	trait = devoted
	trait = zealous
	trait = diligent
	trait = gregarious
	1075.1.1 = {
		birth = yes
	}
	1154.1.1 = {
		add_trait = saint
		death = yes
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:3348 # Dhanop, for his dadabari at Ajmer
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:jainism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_jainism_universal_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
			if = { # No relics: the Jains keep no relics of the body
				limit = {
					title:c_ajayameru.holder ?= { faith = { has_saint_character = character:MB_kharatara_jinadatta } }
				}
				title:c_ajayameru.holder = {
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:MB_kharatara_jinadatta
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:MB_kharatara_jinadatta
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:MB_kharatara_jinadatta
					consume_saint_relic_charge = character:MB_kharatara_jinadatta
				}
				set_global_variable = MB_norelic_MB_kharatara_jinadatta
			}
		}
	}
}

	name = "Tsangpa_Gyare"
	rite = kagyu
	culture = bodpa
	martial = 2
	diplomacy = 7
	intrigue = 5
	stewardship = 6
	learning = 10
	trait = education_learning_4
	trait = devoted
	trait = zealous
	trait = diligent
	1161.1.1 = {
		birth = yes
	}
	1211.1.1 = {
		add_trait = saint
		death = yes
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:9223 # Nagarze, for Ralung
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:buddhism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_buddhism_vajrayana_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:9234 # Daklha Gampo, the monastery he founded
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:buddhism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_buddhism_vajrayana_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		add_trait = saint
		death = yes
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:9053 # Tholing, the temples he built
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:buddhism_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_buddhism_vajrayana_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
